newsitem.title: USA: Sprint gets $8.1 million prison contract.
newsitem.headline: Sprint gets $8.1 million prison contract.

text.p: Sprint Corp said Tuesday it won an $8.1 million contract from the state of Nebraska to provide long-distance telephone services for inmates at 11 state correctional facilities.
The contract is for five years with two one-year options for renewal by the state, Sprint said.
Sprint will provide the service in conjunction with Magnasync Corp and Smart Data Connections Inc.
Under the contract, Sprint and its associates will install collect-call telephones, provide call monitoring and other security equipment, and provide staff members to operate elements of the service.
